subject: CloudHaven onboarding: kickoff time, owner assignment, and deployment constraints
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: CloudHaven onboarding: kickoff time, owner assignment, and deployment constraints

Team / Samantha,

Thanks again for the commitment — thrilled CloudHaven is moving forward with Redwood Dedicated. Quick summary of where we landed in the contract and three asks for the CS/implementation team:

1) Target go-live window: April 4th — requires dedicated capacity to be ready by March 22nd for performance tuning.
2) Deployment mode: VPC-private with customer-managed KMS (they need HSM integration for keys).
3) Acceptance criteria: throughput baseline of 180 qps for the text-gen endpoints at 512 token context with p99 latency under 400ms.

Attachments: CloudHaven_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (MVP milestones + owners); SOW_CloudHaven_v3_redlines.pdf (legal has redlines flagged, see pages 2-4).

A couple of internal notes (please keep private):
- They requested a 20% introductory credit; I've queued for AE approval — Vivek is on that thread.
- Procurement will push DocuSign within 24–48 hours.

Kimberly — can you own the handoff? If you want, assign a CS lead and I'll loop in the customer.

Thanks,
Aditya
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudhaven.com>, Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T11:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudHaven onboarding: kickoff time, owner assignment, and deployment constraints

Aditya — thanks for the summary and the attachments. I'll take the handoff and assign an implementation owner. Overview for CS team:

- I'm assigning Marissa Cole as the primary CS lead for CloudHaven. Marissa — please confirm you can start the intake by next Monday (2/22) and own the milestones in the attached MAP.
- Notes on KMS/HSM: we will need our security engineer to review their KMS requirements; ask Security to validate whether our Managed KMS path is acceptable or if the HSM integration requires Private deployment customization.
- Sizing: Ops should provision dedicated capacity staging cluster sized for 250 qps to have buffer for load testing.

Internal ask: Marissa, please prepare a one-page deployment runbook and a 6-week plan (with owners) to share with CloudHaven by 2/24.

Kimberly Park
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudhaven.com>, Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@cloudhaven.com>, Procurement <procurement@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: CloudHaven implementation plan + proposed kickoff

All — hi, Marissa here. Thanks Kim/Aditya. Quick plan and immediate asks:

Proposed kickoff: 2027-02-24 10:00am PT (60 min) — remote meeting (I will send calendar invite). Agenda: introductions, business objectives, technical constraints (KMS/HSM), test dataset and success metrics, timeline/milestones.

Deliverables I will own by 2/24:
- 6-week implementation plan (owned, milestones + risks)
- Deployment runbook draft (networking, firewall rules, certs, KMS key names)
- Test plan for performance acceptance (load model, test prompts, evaluation metrics)

Open items for CloudHaven to prepare before kickoff:
- Provide primary network contact and public VPC subnet details (or allow us to stage a peering request).
- Confirm the HSM vendor and contact if they require HSM integration (we will need technical contact inside their infra team).
- Complete the SOC2 evidence request spreadsheet (I've attached a trimmed SOC2-evidence-extract.zip to this mail for their reference).

I'll send the calendar invite and a shareable folder with the MAP & SOW redlines after I receive confirmation of the kickoff time.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment stubs: SOC2-evidence-extract.zip (README + list of files)
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@cloudhaven.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Ortiz <daniel.ortiz@cloudhaven.com>, Procurement <procurement@cloudhaven.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: CloudHaven implementation plan + proposed kickoff

Marissa / Kim — 10am PT on 2/24 works for us. I'll ask Daniel (infra) to provide the VPC subnet details and our security lead will pull the HSM vendor contact. Procurement will expect the DocuSign link from Aditya by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
VP Product
CloudHaven
samantha@cloudhaven.com
